summary: Package description that makes the React API client available to the rest of the workspace.
purpose: Names the package, marks it private, and declares its two import paths and its React Query dependency.
why: Likely reason: lets other workspace apps import the API client and the presentation edit helpers by name.
how: Sets the package name and version, marks it private, sets the module type to ES modules, maps the main import and the presentation-edits import to their source files, lists React Query as a dependency, and requires React 18 or newer as a peer.
inputs: The source files at src/index.ts and src/presentation-edits.ts.
outputs: A workspace package that other code can import.
risks: The React Query version comes from a shared version catalog, so updating that catalog changes this package too.
debug: If an import fails, check that each export path points to a real file.
